description: This file contains unit tests for voice wake-up trigger sanitization and locale normalization functions in the OpenClaw project, focusing on trimming, fallback behavior, and input constraints.

methods.name: sanitize triggers trims and drops empty
methods.description: Tests that sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers trims whitespace and drops empty strings.

methods.name: sanitize triggers falls back to defaults
methods.description: Tests fallback to default voice triggers when input contains only whitespace.

methods.name: sanitize triggers limits word length
methods.description: Ensures individual trigger words are limited to voiceWakeMaxWordLength characters.

methods.name: sanitize triggers limits word count
methods.description: Checks that the number of trigger words does not exceed voiceWakeMaxWords.

methods.name: normalize locale strips collation
methods.description: Verifies that collation extensions are removed from locale identifiers.

methods.name: normalize locale strips unicode extensions
methods.description: Ensures unicode extensions are stripped from locale identifiers.
